objective: Restrict PAID CAMPAIGN DELIVERY on the five Search campaigns to Monday-Friday 08:00-20:00 and Saturday 08:00-13:00 America/New_York, with no Sunday delivery, as a protective response to the invalid-click finding.

why.headline: The five campaigns are running a 92.5% filtered-invalid click rate since launch against a 27.9% account baseline over the prior 12 months.
why.overnight_concentration: The 00:00-07:59 block took 9.9% of impressions but 32.1% of charged spend, at $94.60 per charged click against $41.44 in daytime hours. Hours 06:00 ($111.82 per click) and 07:00 ($181.79 per click) are the worst in the account.
why.scope_limit: This schedule closes the worst window. It is NOT a fix for the underlying problem, which is that ClickCease protection is not reaching these five campaigns at all. See clickcease_verification below.

timezone_handling.rule: AdScheduleInfo hours are interpreted in the account time zone. America/New_York is set on the customer, so EST and EDT are handled by Google. No UTC conversion is applied anywhere in this package.

rollback_plan.trigger: Any readback assertion fails, or Green Marketing reverses the decision.
rollback_plan.method: Remove the 30 criteria by the resource names returned in the mutation receipt, in one CampaignCriterionService MutateCampaignCriteria request with partial_failure=false. Removing them returns the campaigns to 24/7, which is the state immediately before this package.
rollback_plan.data_loss: NONE. Ad-schedule criteria hold no performance history of their own; hour-of-day performance stays available through segments.hour.

partial_write_protocol: Send all 30 creates in ONE GoogleAdsService.Mutate request with partial_failure=false. If it fails, STOP, re-query the five campaigns to inventory what actually exists, and produce a recovery plan. Do not blindly rerun, because a blind rerun risks duplicate overlapping rows.

expected_effect.immediate: Closes 00:00-07:59 and all of Sunday to paid delivery. On the 2026-08-14 to 2026-08-20 evidence that window carried $567.61 of $1,769.38 charged spend, so roughly a third of current burn is removed.
expected_effect.not_a_complete_fix: Daytime hours still ran a $41.44 charged CPC and mobile still showed a 93.5% filtered-invalid rate. The schedule buys time; it does not restore click-fraud protection.
expected_effect.no_promise: This does not guarantee a proportional fall in spend. Maximize Clicks may redistribute budget into the remaining open hours.

post_approval_sequence: Repeat the preflight snapshot and confirm the five still carry ZERO ad-schedule criteria, so no duplicate or overlapping row can be created.
Confirm the plan fingerprint still reproduces from the file.
Run validate_only=true on the exact 30 operations.
Stop immediately if any operation fails.
Read every changed resource back and run the readback assertions above.
Then run the 24-hour comparison described in follow_up before any budget proposal.

follow_up_24h_comparison.run_at: 24 hours after the schedule is applied
follow_up_24h_comparison.rule: No budget increase is to be proposed until this comparison is complete.
